an4.192:1.3: Saṃvāsena bhikkhave sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañ ca kho dīghena addhunā na itaraṃ manasikarotā no amanasikārā paññavatā no duppaññenā.
an4.192:1.4: Saṃvohārena bhikkhave soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañ ca kho dīghena addhunā na itaraṃ manasikarotā no amanasikārā paññavatā no duppaññena.
an4.192:1.5: Āpadāsu bhikkhave thāmo veditabbaṃ, so ca kho dīghena addhunā na itaraṃ . . . duppaññena.
an4.192:1.6: Sākacchāya bhikkhave paññā veditabbā, sā ca kho dīghena addhunā na itaraṃ manasikarotā no amanasikārā paññavatā no duppaññena. 2.
an4.192:2.1: Saṃvāsena bhikkhave sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañ ca kho dīghena addhunā . . . duppaññenāti--iti pi
an4.192:2.2: kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ kiñc' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
an4.192:2.3: Idha bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvāsamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:2.4: dīgharattaṃ kho ayaṃ āyasmā khaṇḍakārī chiddakārī sabalakārī kammāsakārī na santatakārī na santatavutti
an4.192:2.5: sīlesu, dussīlo ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā sīlavā ti.
an4.192:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvāsamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:3.2: dīgharattaṃ kho ayaṃ āyasmā akhaṇḍakārī acchiddakārī asabalakārī akammāsakārī santatakārī santatavutti
an4.192:3.3: sīlesu, sīlavā ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā dussīlo ti.
an4.192:3.4: Saṃvāsena bhikkhave sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañ ca kho dīghena addhunā na itaraṃ manasikarotā no amanasikārā paññavatā no duppaññenāti--iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paticca vuttaṃ. 3.
an4.192:4.1: Saṃvohārena bhikkhave soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ tañ ca kho dīghena addhunā . . . duppaññenāti--iti
an4.192:4.2: kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ kiñc' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.192:4.3: Idha bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvohāramāno evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:4.4: aññathā kho ayaṃ āyasmā ekena eko voharati aññathā dvīhi aññathā tīhi aññathā sambahulehi,
an4.192:4.6: aparisuddhavohāro ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā parisuddhavohāro ti.
an4.192:5.1: Idha pana bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvohāramāno evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:5.2: yath' eva kho ayam āyasmā ekena eko voharati tathā dvīhi tathā tīhi tathā sambahulehi,
an4.192:5.4: parisuddhavohāro ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā aparisuddhavohāro ti.
an4.192:5.5: Saṃvohārena bhikkhave soceyyaṃ veditabbaṃ, tañ ca kho . . . idaṃ etaṃ paṭicca vuttam. 4.
an4.192:6.1: Āpadāsu bhikkhave thāmo veditabbo, so ca kho . . . duppaññenāti--iti
an4.192:6.2: kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ kiñc' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.192:6.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco ñātivyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno bhogavyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an4.192:6.4: tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto attabhāvapaṭilābho yathābhūte lokasannivāse yathābhūte attabhāvapaṭilābhe aṭṭha lokadhammā lokaṃ anuparivattanti loko c' aṭṭha lokadhamme anuparivattati
an4.192:6.5: lābho ca alābho ca ayaso ca yaso ca nindā ca pasaṃsā ca sukhañ ca dukkhañ cāti.
an4.192:6.6: So ñātivyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno . . . rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.192:7.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco ñātivyasanena . . . rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an4.192:7.4: So ñātivyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati . . . na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an4.192:8.1: Sākacchāya bhikkhave paññā veditabbā. Sā ca kho . . . duppaññenāti--iti
an4.192:8.2: kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ kiñc' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
an4.192:8.3: Idha bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:8.4: yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhasamudācāro duppañño ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā paññavā.
an4.192:8.6: Tathā hi ayaṃ āyasmā na c' eva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ,
an4.192:8.7: yañ ca ayaṃ āyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati tassa ca na paṭibalo saṅkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ,
an4.192:8.8: duppañño ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā paññavā.
an4.192:9.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave cakkhumā puriso udakarahadassa tīre ṭhito passeyya parittaṃ macchaṃ ummujjamānaṃ,
an4.192:9.3: yathā kho imassa macchassa ummaggo yathā ca ūmighāto yathā ca vegāyitattaṃ paritto ayaṃ maccho nāyaṃ maccho mahanto ti, evam
an4.192:9.4: eva kho bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti . . . pe . . . paññavā ti. Idha bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamano evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:9.5: yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhasamudācāro paññavā ayaṃ āyasmā nāyam āyasmā duppaññā.
an4.192:9.7: Tathā hi ayaṃ āyasmā gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ,
an4.192:10.5: ayaṃ āyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati tassa ca paṭibalo saṅkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ,
an4.192:10.6: paññavā ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā duppañño.
an4.192:11.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave cakkhumā puriso udakarahadassa tīre ṭhito passeyya mahantaṃ macchaṃ ummujjamānaṃ,
an4.192:11.3: yathā kho imassa macchassa ummaggo yathā ca ūmighāto yathā ca vegāyitattaṃ mahanto ayaṃ maccho nāyaṃ maccho paritto ti, evam
an4.192:11.4: eva kho bhikkhave puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an4.192:11.5: yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca pañhasamudācāro, duppañño ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā paññavā.
an4.192:11.7: Tathā hi ayaṃ āyasmā gambhīrañ c' eva atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakkāvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ
an4.192:11.8: yañ ca ayaṃ āyasmā dhammaṃ bhāsati tassa ca paṭibalo saṅkhittena vā vitthārena vā atthaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānikātuṃ,
an4.192:11.9: paññavā ayaṃ āyasmā nāyaṃ āyasmā duppañño ti.
an4.192:12.1: Sākacchāya bhikkhave paññā veditabbā, sā ca kho dīghena addhunā na itaram manasikarotā no amanasikārā paññavatā no duppaññenāti--iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.192:12.2: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri ṭhānāni imehi catuhi ṭhānehi veditabbānīti. 193. 1.
